proof_body:
by
  refine ⟨fun b => ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h n => by rw [h]; exact sum_bernoulli n⟩, bernoulliPowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one ℚ⟩
  funext n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    have h1 := h (n + 1)
    have h2 := sum_bernoulli (n + 1)
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h1 h2
    have hs : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((n + 1).choose k : ℚ) * b k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((n + 1).choose k : ℚ) * bernoulli k :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => by rw [ih k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)])
    rw [hs] at h1
    have hc : (((n + 1).choose n : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Nat.choose_succ_self_right]
      positivity
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hc (add_left_cancel (h1.trans h2.symm))
target_source: (∀ b : ℕ → ℚ, (∀ n : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (n.choose k : ℚ) * b k = if n = 1 then 1 else 0) ↔ b = bernoulli) ∧ (bernoulliPowerSeries ℚ) * (PowerSeries.exp ℚ - 1) = PowerSeries.X
